description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the LDAPSyncService's field validation logic within the LDAP module of the OrangeHRM system. It contains a test method that verifies the correct handling and logging of various LDAP user attribute validation scenarios, including missing attributes, length constraints, and invalid data.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceFieldValidationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that validates LDAP synchronization field constraints and logs validation errors during user data fetching from LDAP.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Sets up a mock LDAP environment with various edge case user entries, invokes the LDAP sync process, and asserts that validation errors are correctly logged and handle different attribute constraints.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates a mock EntryCollection object from an array of LDAP entries and a lookup setting.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Provides a list of sample LDAP entries with diverse attribute configurations to test the validation logic.
